'''Sedni Maruk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Sedni Maruk was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], failing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and remaining in the Order without a rank. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Maruk returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

When he failed as a Jedi, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] allowed him to remain with the Order and stationed Maruk at the ancient ruins of the fortress city [[Kaleth]]. During his time there, Maruk became increasingly distressed at the number of [[horranth]]s plaguing the region.<ref name="TOR" />
